desc: Implement input parsing, frequency maps, `maxKnown`, and early cases `uA + uB >= N` / `T <= 1`.
Implement exact pair-sum check using packed `(sum, weight=min(cntA[a], cntB[b]))` entries, filtering sums below `maxKnown`, sorting, and aggregating weights by sum.
Validate on samples and edge cases: all `-1`, duplicates, `T=1`, large values, and sums below `maxKnown`.
